importantNote: Automatic Firebase Cloud data synchronization, user data auto-rendering, account profile view, and mobile navigation are active.

items: Enabled automatic Firebase Cloud data synchronization for Favorites and Playlists on user authentication.
Added real-time listeners for `favoritesSynced` and `playlistsSynced` to immediately render stored user data on app open.
Guaranteed 100% data persistence between device sessions and Service Worker cache updates.
Fixed script syntax closing brackets in `home.js` to ensure immediate and smooth app startup on all devices.
Cleared invalid cached script references via Service Worker cache invalidation.
Restored complete Account Profile page rendering (`renderProfile`).
View active user avatar, Firebase account status, and quick stats (Liked Songs, Playlists, History).
Update account password directly from profile and manage session logouts.
Enabled top-left hamburger menu button to toggle smooth slide-out sidebar drawer on mobile.
Full access to working features: Home, Search, Playlists, Favorites, Connect, Vibe AI, Profile, Settings, and Logout.
Dark glass backdrop overlay with tap-to-close interaction.
